correctness.rationale: Independent exact rational hidden-state enumeration (729 combinations) agrees with the derived moment expansion; the all-parameter proof checks the 0/1 state transition law, all three Bernoulli moments, strict positivity of A and B even at detection probability one, strict convexity in cumulative relaxation hazard, and endpoint equality cases. The claimed invariance of the optimizer under varying middle sensitivity follows from its exact cancellation in A/B. Stationarity persists under a positive common generator multiplier.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial fixed-endpoint observation schedule, involving exactly three heterogeneous detections of a persisting but intermittently visible species, has a complete three-regime optimality law with sharp endpoint-collapse thresholds and clock-change robustness. The independence from the movable observation’s own detection quality is a non-obvious structural simplification with direct decision relevance for sparse survey planning; the theorem deliberately does not claim a general occupancy estimator or nonlinear biological model.
